notes: Alternatives picking: the recognizer returns up to 3 guesses and the best one is now picked (source-language script, then confidence, then Google order) instead of always taking the first; one compact alternatives line is logged per final, and the Voice tab shows the other guesses as tappable chips that re-translate the exact tapped text. Picking only helps when the correct text is among the 3 alternatives - accuracy is phone-unproven, the phone log decides. No new STT engine, no new permissions.
